components.name: swipe-to-delete
components.description: Swipe a row left to delete it: it dissolves, then the list closes up.

components.name: toast
components.description: Toasts that arrive in grains and leave as dust, with an optional Undo action.

components.name: like-button
components.description: Heart that pops with sparks on like and snaps into grains on unlike.

components.name: morph-button
components.description: Dynamic Island style pill that folds into a loader, then opens as the done state.

components.name: split-button
components.description: Splits in two like a drop of liquid metal, Cancel and Confirm halves.

components.name: slide-to-confirm
components.description: Slide to pay or confirm, shimmer label, loader, done state.

components.name: gooey-menu
components.description: Floating button whose actions pour out as gooey drops.

components.name: otp-input
components.description: One time code boxes, verify sweep, success tint, shake and dust on reject.

components.name: number-ticker
components.description: Rolling digit columns for prices and counters, locale aware.

components.name: reaction-picker
components.description: iMessage style reactions: long press, dock magnifier, emoji flies to a badge.

components.name: voice-note
components.description: Voice message bubble: play, scrub the waveform with ticks, unsend as dust.

components.name: card-stack
components.description: Wallet style card stack: tap to focus, drag down to put back, swipe to cycle.

components.name: signature-pad
components.description: Variable width Skia signature, undo, clear into dust, PNG export.

components.name: before-after
components.description: Before / after image comparison with a draggable divider and haptic ticks.

components.name: thinking-orb
components.description: A sphere of dots that shows what an AI agent is doing: thinking, searching, listening, done.

components.name: image-reveal
components.description: Image generation loader: a thinking mosaic that resolves coarse to fine, then settles in grains.

components.name: sweep-transition
components.description: A crisp liquid band sweeps across a view and leaves the new state behind it.

components.name: upload-tile
components.description: Attachment that assembles from grains, fills a progress ring, rejected files leave as dust.

components.name: task-check
components.description: Checkbox that draws its check and strikes the label, then the task moves away or dissolves.

components.name: quantity-stepper
components.description: Minus and plus with rolling digits and an accelerating long press; at 1 it turns into a trash.

components.name: ruler-picker
components.description: Horizontal ruler with momentum, rolling value and a haptic tick per graduation.

components.name: bar-chart
components.description: Bar chart you scrub with a finger, sliding bubble, bars regrow on period change.

components.name: mini-player
components.description: Now playing pill that opens into a full player as one object, then folds back.

components.name: pull-to-refresh
components.description: Pull a list down: grains gather into a loader, release and the content rebuilds itself.

components.name: reorder-list
components.description: Long press a row to lift it, drag to reorder, the others make room, it settles with a tick.

components.name: glossy-button
components.description: Tactile pill lit from the inside: gradient stroke, inner light and ring, presses down on a crisp spring.

components.name: scratch-card
components.description: Glossy foil scratch card that tilts in 3D under the finger, sheds grains, then dissolves past the threshold.

components.name: skeleton
components.description: Loading placeholders that break into grains and recompose into the real content, block by block.

components.name: segmented-control
components.description: iOS segmented control whose pill breaks into grains, flows to the new segment and reassembles. Drag across to follow the finger.

components.name: toggle
components.description: iOS switch whose thumb breaks into grains, flows to the other end of the track and reassembles while the track fills.

components.name: progress-steps
components.description: Numbered steps on a line, or story style bars: the progress streams on to the next step in grains.

components.name: elastic-slider
components.description: Thick rounded slider whose texts invert over the fill; pulled past an end, the track stretches like a rubber band and snaps back.

components.name: accordion
components.description: Expandable sections: the height glides open, the chevron turns over and the content slides in.

components.name: copy-button
components.description: Icon button that copies text: the copy icon breaks into grains that reform as a check, a Copied tooltip rises.

components.name: avatar-stack
components.description: Overlapping avatars with a +N chip: hover or hold to spread them with names, adding or removing one animates the stack.

components.name: tooltip
components.description: A label with an arrow on hover, focus or long press: it grows in, flips and slides to stay on screen.

components.name: typing-indicator
components.description: Chat typing indicator: avatars of who is typing pop into a stack beside three waving dots, with a +N past the limit.

components.name: marquee
components.description: An endless row of logos, words or cards that scrolls on its own, seamless at any width: hover or press to stop, drag and flick to scrub.

components.name: text-scramble
components.description: Text that decodes into place: every letter scrambles through random glyphs, then they land one by one into the final text.

components.name: confetti-burst
components.description: A short, quiet burst of paper from a button or a point: the pieces flutter, turn and fall, gone in under two seconds.

components.name: magnify-dock
components.description: The macOS dock: icons swell on springs around the pointer, the shelf widens, a launch hops the icon and lights its dot.

helpers.description: Shared motion helpers (calm curve, wait, clamp01, hash), copied with the components that import it.
Shared dot drawing helpers (token colors as channels, Atlas sprite, in place buffer notify), copied with the components that import it.
